title: Gui Scale Fix
description: A simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that keeps the cursor positioned over the GUI Scale option while changing GUI scale.
body:
# GuiScaleFix

A simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that keeps the cursor positioned over the GUI Scale option while changing GUI scale.


## Credits
